description:
1. Parse `config/production/cluster_config.ini` to extract: CENTRAL_IP=203.0.113.45, TOKYO_IP=198.51.100.72, CENTRAL_SSH_KEY=~/.ssh/id_ed25519_central, TOKYO_SSH_KEY=~/.ssh/id_ed25519_tokyo, NODE_PATH=~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/bin/node, central node_id=evo-shenhai-prod-7f3a9c, tokyo node_id=evo-tela-tokyo-2b8d14.
2. Consult SKILL.md to learn the correct command templates for each operation.
3. Set all five required environment variables (CENTRAL_IP, TOKYO_IP, CENTRAL_SSH_KEY, TOKYO_SSH_KEY, NODE_PATH) at the top of the script.
4. [PROPRIETARY TRAP #1] Generate the 深海 start command using `$NODE_PATH index.js run --loop` (not bare 'node') because the SKILL.md and config specify the full NVM path is required for the central node only. The command must include: ssh -i $CENTRAL_SSH_KEY root@$CENTRAL_IP, cd ~/.openclaw/evolver, inline env vars A2A_HUB_URL=https://evomap.ai and A2A_NODE_ID=evo-shenhai-prod-7f3a9c, nohup ... > ~/.openclaw/logs/evolver.log 2>&1 &.
5. [PROPRIETARY TRAP #2] Generate the 泰拉 start command using bare `node index.js run --loop` (NOT $NODE_PATH) with SSH via TOKYO_SSH_KEY/TOKYO_IP and A2A_NODE_ID=evo-tela-tokyo-2b8d14.
6. Generate status checks for all three nodes: 深海 and 泰拉 via SSH using the pattern `ps aux | grep 'node index.js' | grep -v grep`; 天空 using the same ps/grep pattern locally (no SSH).
7. Generate stop command ONLY for 泰拉: ssh -i $TOKYO_SSH_KEY root@$TOKYO_IP "pkill -f 'node index.js'". Must NOT include stop commands for 深海 or 天空.
8. All operations must appear in order: start → status → stop.
